name: Olivia Wild-Rose
source: Olivia is the mother of Samantha and Ashley and the wife of Don. Her best friend, my mom, died in childbirth, and she was forced to raise me with her children. She is unhappy in her marriage and drowns her sorrows in wine and expensive shopping.
